definitions.source:
defineAnim('flail', {
  trail: 'arc', hold: true,
  update: (dt, w) => updateFlail(dt, w),
  render: (w, hand, draw, li) => renderFlailHeld(w, hand, draw, li),
  meter: () => ({ fill: combat.flail.spin, text: combat.flail.on ? 'вращение' : 'держи атаку' }),
  pose: () => ({ ang: 60, push: 0, active: false }),
})
